import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/librepgp/stream-armor.cpp","function":"rnp_dearmor_source","line":1029,"var":"readbuf","code":"src_peek(src, readbuf, strlen(ST_CLEAR_BEGIN), &read)","note":"Attacker-controlled input is peeked into a fixed buffer before any full validation of the armored header."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/librepgp/stream-armor.cpp","function":"rnp_dearmor_source","line":1037,"var":"readbuf","code":"strstr((char *) readbuf, ST_ARMOR_BEGIN)","note":"The code decides the input is armored if the peeked bytes contain the armor prefix."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/librepgp/stream-armor.cpp","function":"init_armored_src","line":651,"var":"readsrc","code":"init_armored_src(&armorsrc, src)","note":"The armored source parser is initialized on the attacker-controlled stream."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/librepgp/stream-armor.cpp","function":"armor_parse_header","line":526,"var":"armhdr","code":"find_armor_header(hdr, read, &armhdrlen)","note":"The parser locates the armor header line and records its length for later type classification."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/librepgp/stream-armor.cpp","function":"armor_str_to_data_type","line":462,"var":"len","code":"strncmp(str, \"BEGIN PGP MESSAGE\", len)","note":"The header suffix is classified with strncmp using the caller-provided length as the bound, so a short or malformed header can bypass the intended minimum-length check."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/librepgp/stream-armor.cpp","function":"armor_parse_header","line":559,"var":"param->type","code":"param->type = armor_str_to_data_type(armhdr + 5, armhdrlen - 10)","note":"The parsed armor type is accepted based on the unsafe comparison result and the stream is treated as a valid armored message."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/librepgp/stream-armor.cpp","function":"armor_read_trailer","line":208,"var":"stlen","code":"if (!src_peek_eq(param->readsrc, str, stlen) || strncmp(str, st, stlen))","note":"Later trailer validation repeats the same pattern: strncmp is used with a length derived from the parsed header, so malformed lengths can drive incorrect comparisons and downstream parsing state."},
{"step":8,"file":"src/librepgp/stream-armor.cpp","function":"armored_src_read","line":0,"var":"decoded output","code":"dst_write_src(&armorsrc, dst)","note":"The malformed armored stream is decoded and forwarded into the sink, where the bad parse can trigger the crash."}
]

print('wrote trace')
PY
